name: Daern's Instant Fortress

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Raise the fortress
powers.text: Set it down and speak the word: a stone tower 20 ft square and 30 ft high rises. Rest inside it in safety.

summary: A tiny cube that grows into a stone tower you can rest in safely, then shrinks back.
text: You can take a Magic action to place this 1-inch metal cube on the ground and speak its command word. The cube rapidly grows into a fortress that remains until you take a Magic action to speak the command word that dismisses it, which works only if the fortress is empty. The fortress is a square tower, 20 feet on a side and 30 feet high, with arrow slits on all sides and a battlement atop it. Its interior is divided into two floors, with a ladder running along one wall to connect them. The ladder ends at a trapdoor leading to the roof. When activated, the cube has a door on the side facing you. The door opens only at your command, which you can speak as a Bonus Action. It is immune to the Knock spell and similar magic. Each creature in the area where the fortress appears must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d10 Bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In either case, the creature is pushed to an unoccupied space outside but next to the fortress. In the game, raising it lets the party take a Long Rest in safety wherever they are.
